interface.name: Dedicated Wi-Fi interface
interface.description: Exact Linux name, e.g. wlan0, wlan1 or wlx. Use the same name in both apps. Integrated and USB Wi-Fi are supported. Never select Home Assistant's active network.

pairing_token.name: Pairing secret
pairing_token.description: Enter the same private secret of at least 32 characters in both apps.

run_timeout.name: Session timeout (seconds)
run_timeout.description: Maximum duration including menu input and device discovery. Default: 30 minutes.
